name: offboarding
title: A leaver's credentials are revoked and what they held is reviewed
description: When a person is deactivated, revoke the sessions and API keys still live for them, record what they hold in the organization, and open a review for an administrator. Installed as drafts: nothing runs until a person publishes the process and then the recipe with publish_granted, so its steps run within that person's authority and the recipe runner's.
